verdict.rationale: mParticle's Data Privacy Controls record a consent state that covers both GDPR consent and CCPA data-sale opt-out. Forwarding rules such as 'Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present' enforce that state at the destination level, and a dedicated Consent Filters guide also exists. missing for 10: detailed documentation of per-category (GDPR purpose) consent configuration and of how consent is captured through the SDKs, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that enforcement works across destinations.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, user consent is captured and enforced across destinations — opt-outs and consent categories are honored downstream automatically

citations.quote: Consent state powers both GDPR consent and CCPA data sale opt-out
Applying a forwarding rule of: Do not forward if CCPA Data sale opt out is present.
